audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0 and 4 were given to Zaahen on both layers while the packet levelChart marks both Skill — and the whys already read 'Level 1 is even' and 'Level 6 is even', so the chart contradicted its own explanation.
audit.why: Level 1 Zaahen has no gap-close and Kassadin farms safely behind Null Sphere's shield; at 6 Riftwalk arrives, which the page itself calls a coin-flip.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 4 set to Skill on both layers, ratings dropped from 8/10 to 5/10 so they match the side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was framed as a cooldown window to punish; the page treats Riftwalk as a spell you can wait out.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2 seconds at 500 range. It is never meaningfully on cooldown — what limits it is the stacking mana cost, not the timer.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, whys[4] and breakdown.mid rewritten around the 5s blink and the escalating mana cost, with the punish moved onto Zaahen's own 14s/850-range W pull.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire page schedules commits around 'Riftwalk's cooldown' — a 5-second spell — and never mentions the one tool that actually answers a blink: Zaahen's W, a 850-range pull on 14/13.5/13/12.5/12.
audit.why: Zaahen's W damages in a direction then pulls enemies toward him; that is the only thing in his kit that undoes a Riftwalk landing. His R has no crowd control at all, it heals for a portion of damage dealt. Additionally Kassadin's Nether Blade (W) is an auto-attack reset, so his burst opens on an attack wind-up rather than a visible cast — the flagged missing interaction.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text and wants.you[2] around the W pull and the Nether Blade reset tell; added Force Pulse's 21s rank-1 cooldown as the punishable one.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'When Riftwalk is down, run your full pattern' is unactionable advice against a 5s blink.
audit.why: Force Pulse at 21/20/19/18/17 is the genuinely punishable cooldown, and it also has to charge from spells cast nearby before he can use it.
audit.corrected: breakdown.mid points the trading window at Force Pulse and at Zaahen's own pull instead.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1 and 2s at rank 3 — you cannot wait it out, so stop scheduling around it. - Your W pull (14s, 850 range) is what catches him after he blinks: hold it, never open with it. - Force Pulse: 21s at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Kassadin's Riftwalk before you commit
edits.after: Hold your W pull for the moment after he blinks

edits.before: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Riftwalk is a 5s blink, not a window — your 850-range pull is the answer once he lands.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Riftwalk: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Riftwalk is never 'down' — it is 5s. Trade instead around Force Pulse (21s) and your own W pull, and if ahead freeze and starve him.

edits.before: Kassadin is helpless pre-6: his Q (Null Sphere) shield only blanks magic and his passive gives magic resist, neither of which helps against your physical Q (Darkin Glaive) and autos. Walk him down every wave, force him off the caster minions, and deny him farm and XP so his scaling never arrives.
edits.after: Kassadin is helpless pre-6: Null Sphere (Q) shields only against magic and his passive is magic reduction, neither of which touches your physical Q and autos. His trade opens with a Nether Blade (W) auto-reset, so the attack wind-up is the tell to step back. Walk him down and deny him farm and XP.

edits.before: Kass gets R (Riftwalk) at 6 and can finally poke-and-blink, but he's still low-mana and squishy; if he Riftwalks in you punish with E (Golden Onslaught) into R (Final Retribution) before he can stack his ult cost. Keep him off level 16.
edits.after: Kass gets Riftwalk at 6 and can poke-and-blink, but it is a 500-range hop on 5s, not an escape you can wait out: answer it with your 850-range W pull the instant he lands, then Q and R. Each extra blink costs him more mana. Keep him off 16.

edits.before: Level 6 is even: Kass gets Riftwalk mobility but thin mana keeps it a coin-flip.
edits.after: Level 6 is even: Riftwalk is a 5s blink, but stacking mana costs cap his uses.

edits.before: Punish any pre-6 or post-6 Riftwalk step-up with E (Golden Onslaught) into R
edits.after: Catch the Riftwalk landing with your 850-range W pull, then commit E and R

edits.before: Use R (Riftwalk) to poke and disengage without committing
edits.after: Poke and disengage with Riftwalk, backing off on a 5s blink

notes: The packet levelChart gives row 6 (2+ items) to Zaahen, but both layers currently say Skill and the prose reasons for it (Kassadin carry threat 9.5/10, full-item scaling). Zaahen's ability names remain unverifiable: the kit file has slots only, the content layer says Darkin Glaive / Golden Onslaught / Final Retribution, the mirror audit says The Darkin Glaive / Aureate Rush / Grim Deliverance.
